reviews.title: Pretty serious gaming keyboard
reviews.comment: Maybe I just got lucky with mine, but for someone who usually doesn’t buy refurbished/used/etc, I’m so glad I got this. It’s a great keyboard that sounds good and is nice to play games with, definitely a step above from my previous mechanical keyboard that had clicky switches that were harder to press. The actuation point takes some getting used to, but you can adjust it if it’s too sensitive for you. I personally allowed myself time to adjust to the stock setting and am really glad I did, it’s lightning fast and easy! It also came with all the bonus items like the key puller and space bar swap. Great keyboard at a great price!! One thing to note, you may run into an issue where the wireless mode refuses to connect. I don’t remember exactly what I did, but all I did was look my problem up on google and the solution was quick and easy. Haven’t had any issues since!
reviews.author: Ralfo Manzur

reviews.title: Stylish, responsive, and compact — with a few software and comfort hiccups.
reviews.comment:
I was looking for a compact wireless RGB mechanical keyboard that wouldn’t take up much space on my desk. Since most of my PC setup is Corsair, I wanted something that would match — and this keyboard fit the bill perfectly.
✅ What I Like
I really like the look and feel of this keyboard. The RGB lighting looks great, and if you can catch it on sale like I did, it’s an amazing value. Battery life has been solid — it holds a charge well even with the lights on.
Typing feels smooth and responsive with a nice tactile feel that isn’t too loud or harsh. It only took a short time to get used to the function key layout, and my typing speed has been excellent on it.
⚙️ What Could Be Better
I’ve always had some trouble with Corsair’s iCUE software, and this keyboard is no exception. It worked fine at first, but I had to reset it a few times to get the RGB lighting to sync properly. Once it’s set up, it’s great — but the setup process can be a little finicky.
Another downside is ergonomics. The keyboard isn’t the most comfortable for long sessions. I noticed some wrist fatigue after extended use, though short typing sessions were fine. A wrist rest or better posture would probably help with that.
💬 Final Thoughts
Overall, this is a great compact keyboard with excellent build quality, beautiful RGB lighting, and responsive mechanical switches. The software quirks and ergonomic comfort are the main drawbacks, but if you’re already in the Corsair ecosystem and can find it on sale, it’s a fantastic buy.
